description: The world on one date in a single answer: the dated entries for that exact day, births and deaths that day, every state's office holders that year, the Billboard Hot 100 No. 1 in force, U.S. prices and CPI, world population, official series (unemployment, rates, GDP, debt, CO2, temperature), Federal Reserve exchange rates for that day, and that year's Nobel Prizes. Each part carries its source; parts no source covers are absent.
name: get_world_on_date
